chose: A week written before ready answers (some-ui.interview-week/1) offers a question's last two rungs only, Say it from cues and Say it your way, numbered 1 and 2; with no cue words of its own, Say it from cues leans on the question's "What to cover" lines. Nothing says what is missing.
options: the last two rungs, cues from what to cover
all four, the first two saying there is no ready answer this week
gray: A /1 week has no answer to read or read aloud; whether its absence shows is something the owner would see on screen.
undo: Have stepsOf return ["own"] on a /1 week, or all four with the first two drawn as unavailable.
